cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Don't call the taxi yet. We're packed, but we haven't settled last night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised for telling my sister about your debt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Stay a minute. I can't face her checking what I order tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's already paid for dinner. We'll be late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll be late. Sit with me and help me believe you're coming as my partner, not to report how grateful I am.

mechanism: A professionally separates an apology and paid dinner from repaired trust, directing a partner to stay and settle how private information will be handled.
confusable: D75 seeks emotional-cost acknowledgement; D74 must retain the person physically until relationship feels repaired despite practical readiness.
comparison: Dishes alternative uses a bus-limited conversation; dinner alternative refuses taxi readiness and prepaid-meal urgency after private debt disclosure.
seedUse: Packed bags, taxi, sister debt disclosure, prepaid dinner and partner trust derive from D74-b; S03 adds exact apology-versus-repair correction.
